question: Should Microsoft Teams permanently support `channels.msteams.accounts` and `channels.msteams.defaultAccount` while retaining root-level credentials as an implicit legacy default account?
rationale: This is a durable public configuration and inheritance contract whose long-term compatibility obligations cannot be settled by implementation correctness or test coverage alone.

options.title: Accept the hybrid contract
options.body: Retain root-level legacy compatibility and named accounts after the unrelated glossary cleanup and exact-head gates complete.

options.title: Require account-only migration
options.body: Migrate legacy root identity into `accounts.default` through doctor and support one canonical runtime configuration shape.

options.title: Defer multi-account Teams
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want to own this Teams-specific public surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the hybrid contract
recommendation.body: Retain root-level legacy compatibility and named accounts after the unrelated glossary cleanup and exact-head gates complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest Teams feature-history signal and was directly asked to decide this public contract.
